description: The lambda's secrets by name - never their values: whether secrets are switched on, what is stored and when, which names the code reads with Secret.Read and have no value yet (missing) - what the user still has to set - and which it only uses when they are there, checked with Secret.Exists (optional). With feature, that feature's copy.
